name: Vote 17 Choice
definition: Choice between a vote per agenda resolution and vote for all agenda resolutions.

VotePerAgendaResolution.name: Vote Per Agenda Resolution
VotePerAgendaResolution.definition: Vote instruction is provided individually for each agenda resolution.

VoteForAllAgendaResolutions.name: Vote For All Agenda Resolutions
VoteForAllAgendaResolutions.definition: One single vote instruction is provided to cover all agenda resolutions.
